note: Measured design facts the checks assert against, so a confirmed decision cannot be reversed by accident. apply-decisions.cjs rewrites this file when the decisions land.

hireEffectNormalDifficulty.note: Profit change from hiring one worker in month one on normal difficulty, per route.

hireEffectHardModeLateHire.note: Profit change from hiring in month six on hard mode for the boutique route. Negative before the decisions land, positive afterwards, because the longer commission hours make a premium commission capacity limited.
